requirements_summary: Small devtools startup building a code-assistant that needs hosted API for self-serve onboarding. Workload: interactive code completions + multi-file long-context summarization (10k-50k tokens in aggregate per session). Latency target: median <500ms for short completions, <1.5s acceptable for longer codegen. Throughput: dozens of concurrent developers in POC, scale later. Constraints: strict rate-limit behavior (per-team keys), SDKs (TypeScript + Python) with streaming + reconnect/resume, cost sensitivity (want cost estimates and guardrails), security: SSO + audit logs + retention controls. Model preference: open models with verified performance; fallback to smaller variants during spikes. POC length: 3 weeks; success metrics: latency SLOs met, token cost below threshold, simple SDK integration in <2 days.
